::: {.lx-intro}
One small fictional town and a power grid you run yourself. Start with a game, then climb as far as you like: from how the grid works to building and questioning your own models.
:::

```{=html}
<div class="lx-metro" data-lx-metro data-list="#lx-list"></div>
```

::: {#learn-list}
:::

::: {.lx-landing-note}
Reference: the [regional profile cards](regions.html), twelve energy systems in one structure with dated key numbers, the [glossary](glossary.html), and the <a href="../reference-data/">reference data handbook</a>.
Prairie Town is fictional; every real-world number in the lessons carries a source and a date. Your guesses and progress stay in this browser, as long as it keeps site data; nothing is sent anywhere. Written by Honglin Li.
